lyrics:
[Intro: buzzing fast synth riff, straight into the hook]
Oh-oh, don't hang up yet

[Verse 1: rough young tenor, fast, punchy drums]
I said I'd change and I meant it for a week
I said I'd call and I waited till you'd sleep
I know the script, I'm the one who always bends it
Every sorry that I send, you could have penned it

[Chorus: both voices, full synths, driving beat]
Oh-oh, don't hang up yet
I've got one more thing and I haven't said it
Oh-oh, give me ten more seconds
I'll get it right, I swear I'm getting better
Don't hang up yet

[Verse 2: smooth tenor, higher, melodic]
I can hear you breathing, I can hear the television
I can hear you weighing up a very fair decision
I've been every kind of late and every kind of wrong
But I'm here, and I am asking, and it won't take long

[Chorus: both voices, full synths, driving beat]
Oh-oh, don't hang up yet
I've got one more thing and I haven't said it
Oh-oh, give me ten more seconds
I'll get it right, I swear I'm getting better
Don't hang up yet

[Bridge: beat drops for two bars, voices close]
Nine, eight, seven
Still there?

[Final Chorus: everything, falsetto harmony on top]
Oh-oh, don't hang up yet
I've got one more thing and I haven't said it
Oh-oh, give me ten more seconds
I'll get it right, I swear I'm getting better
Don't hang up yet

[Outro: synth riff cuts off, a dial tone]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 170 BPM, 4/4, D-flat major. A flat-out sprint. Urgent, bright and over quickly.

VOICE: Two men. The first is young with a rough, cracked, slightly nasal tenor and an Australian edge, half singing and half shouting. The second is smooth, polished and higher, with clean runs and a falsetto harmony. They sing the choruses together.

INSTRUMENTS: A buzzing, distorted synthesiser playing a fast, simple riff, the main hook. A punchy, fast drum beat between pop-punk and synth-pop. A thick synth bass. Bright pads. A filtered sweep before each chorus. A phone dial tone at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the synth riff and one line of the hook. 0:08 Verse 1. 0:30 Chorus 1. 0:52 Verse 2, the second voice. 1:14 Chorus 2. 1:36 Bridge, two bars with the beat dropped. 1:44 Final chorus with a falsetto harmony. 2:10 Outro, the riff cuts off mid-phrase into a dial tone at 2:20.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2020s hyper-compact pop: loud, bright and tightly compressed, no intro to speak of, no wasted bars.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The abrupt cut to a dial tone at the end.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: Verse 2 listens to the other end of the line: the television, the breathing, a fair decision being weighed. The second singer sounds like someone who has learned that the other person owes him nothing.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Excuses, honesty, a countdown, an open ending.
